name: WP Grid Builder
couldBuild: Faceted filtering over WP_Query with AJAX refresh, plus a grid layout with card templates. The query layer is well-trodden ground.
stillMissing: Facet counts that stay correct as other facets narrow the set, and staying fast on a large catalogue — that is an indexing problem, not a query problem. Then the integrations with every builder and custom-fields plugin people expect it to read.
requirements: Facet types: checkbox, range, select, search, with combinable state
Correct result counts as facets interact, not just naive counts
An index or cache so filtering stays fast past a few thousand posts
URL state so a filtered view can be shared and indexed
Grid layouts with card templates and responsive columns
